categories.name: Admission NC
categories.description: Patient is admitted to a non-critical inpatient ward, advancing the goal of inpatient care. It is measured against post-discharge outcomes.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative 15 (Admission NC) under the OR-decomposed goal 5. It is realized in variants such as V0008.

categories.name: Admission IC
categories.description: Patient is admitted to an intensive care inpatient ward, contributing to immediate care but negatively impacting time-to-treatment softgoals.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative 16 (Admission IC) under the OR-decomposed goal 5, supported by variants such as V0605.

categories.name: Release A
categories.description: Admitted case reaches a captured discharge type A, helping avoid post-discharge deterioration and measured against post-discharge ER return indicators.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative 17 (Release A) under the OR-decomposed goal 6, observed in variants like V0008.

categories.name: Release B
categories.description: Admitted case reaches a captured discharge type B, helping avoid post-discharge deterioration.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative 18 (Release B) under the OR-decomposed goal 6, observed in variants like V0068.

categories.name: Release C
categories.description: Admitted case reaches a captured discharge type C, representing a specific discharge disposition.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative 19 (Release C) under the OR-decomposed goal 6, observed in variant V0710.

categories.name: Release D
categories.description: Admitted case reaches a captured discharge type D, representing an alternative discharge disposition.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative 20 (Release D) under the OR-decomposed goal 6, observed in variant V0273.

categories.name: Release E
categories.description: Admitted case reaches a captured discharge type E, representing an alternative discharge disposition.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative 21 (Release E) under the OR-decomposed goal 6.
